Fresh exact-head Windows Ops native-ASAR qualification is pending for this target; neither prior .cloga.16 nor alpha32 qualification is transferred. No local installation or activation is claimed.

The deployment acceptance contract requires real host-entry import probes. Web/headless evidence must remain separate from the reserved Desktop profile and does not establish Desktop Models readiness.
Desktop native provisioning owns reserved-profile composition and health verification. The Windows Ops adapter preserves delegation and never falls back to external profile materialization.

notes: Model prompts, images, and hosted-search queries are sent directly to GitHub Copilot by DSH's built-in pi-ai adapter and this plugin.

evidence.description: Published 0.7.1 peers and source tests admit exact official 0.1.6-alpha.1, modern persistence handles, public Session seq freshness and optional activation. Root-Session ownership, native Sidebar fallback and Host restart reconciliation remain bounded contracts, not local live evidence.

Independently downloaded immutable Release 389294372 assets through the authenticated gate; verified annotated tag commit, size, SHA-256, SHA-512/SRI and SHA256SUMS. No new import, Web mount or scheduled-turn smoke was performed.

notes: Scheduled prompts are sent to the configured external LLM when tasks fire.

Version 0.7.1 restricts model tools and task HTTP operations to the owning root Session; the optional global hub exposes only owner-level counts/next-run metadata, and task transfer is a direct-human-only command.
HTTP sessionId is client-supplied; loopback/trusted-host and same-origin checks provide operational separation, not authentication against a malicious local process.
Nonterminal delivered/running history is closed as interrupted after Host restart; tasks and history persist under DSH_HOME.
Windows native system notifications are not implemented and configured systemNotify flags are quiet no-ops.

evidence.description: The exact package manifest is private dsh-memory-evolve 0.1.0, exposes lib/index.js and lib/client.js, declares no dependencies or DSH peer range, and has no install lifecycle script.
The exact Host source was reviewed for injected DSH services, default and optional tool surfaces, filesystem locations, background features, and runtime disposal paths.
The updater performs a background origin tag check and offers an explicit Git fetch plus detached-checkout self-update path; the reviewed Release has no packaged assets or checksum manifest.
The reviewed commit contains an MIT license.

notes: The default data root is DSH_HOME/memories, while managed skills default to ~/.agents/skills; disabling or uninstalling the plugin unregisters runtime surfaces but intentionally retains data and skill files.

The memory and skill-management tools are always registered; todos and direct channel sending are enabled by default. Optional switches can add prompt injection and editing, background review, local file and Codex-session search, external CLI dispatch, DSH Session creation or wake, Git-backed memory synchronization, and channel notifications.

Startup performs a cached background git ls-remote check against the plugin origin. A user-triggered Web update can fetch a tag and replace the plugin worktree with a detached checkout after repository and ancestry checks.

No immutable Release asset, checksum manifest, declared DSH compatibility range, isolated composition mount, or functional smoke is recorded. First use should remain in an isolated Profile while data retention, automatic writes, self-update, external execution, and messaging boundaries are reviewed.

evidence.description: The exact 0.1.6 subprocess range, async Sandbox/Shell, Host-side ToolRuntime/PTC binding authority, Node PTC empty-environment boundary, workflow cleanup, lossless JSON, canonical-path, and Fiber-owned lifecycle findings are documented with the source.

The plugin registers five tools in a real 0.1.6 Cordis/ToolRuntime harness, uses the subprocess service with managed-range quiescence and explicit truncation failure, returns only lossless JSON values, and unregisters every contribution on Fiber disposal.

Official commit 0a15e36e7f82b6ed45af6fa9759f29b40dcd965d and its ToolRunContext, subprocess, Sandbox, Shell, Host PTC binding dispatch, isolated worker environment, workflow, and JSON source seams are checked before compatibility is claimed.

notes: Provides development, patching, build, upgrade, and doctor operations; use only in trusted maintenance sessions.
Strict sandbox escalation and Host grants are ToolRuntime/PTC deployment policy rather than a guarantee of this plugin; configure standing permissions before consequential calls.
The dsh_upgrade check operation queries the configured Git remote; other managed subprocesses act on local operator-selected paths.
